summary: Ashfords is a multidisciplinary accounting and advisory firm in Dandenong South, Melbourne, led by CEO Greg Cusack, who also chairs AGN Asia Pacific. It is a Xero Platinum Partner with an Ashfords Digital automation arm and an offshore team in the Philippines, and in November 2026 hosted AGN's World Congress in Sydney. A follow-up to Greg's earlier email is drafted with new angles.

hooks.text: Ashfords Digital sells automation to clients, so automating its own bookkeeping reconciliations is a natural next step.
Offshore team plus a stated belief in systems for fast onboarding fits a standardised, traceable reconciliation process.
Greg is just back from hosting the AGN World Congress, a good moment for a light check-in.

risks.text: Greg's email address is a firm-pattern guess not verified; an earlier email already went out (23 Nov).
As a Xero Platinum Partner with its own digital/automation arm, Ashfords may already have preferred reconciliation tooling or compete on advisory.
The offshore headcount and systems post are from 2023, so may be out of date.

gaps: No recent posts by Greg himself found beyond the firm's World Congress post.
Specific reconciliation or AI tools used by the firm not found.
COO Tim Szonyi's activity not researched in depth.
